paragraphs.source_en: “I won’t,” said her mother, seeing the tears in her daughter’s eyes; “but one thing, my love; you promised me you would have no secrets from me. You won’t?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Never, mamma, none,” answered Kitty, flushing a little, and looking her mother straight in the face, “but there’s no use in my telling you anything, and I... I... if I wanted to, I don’t know what to say or how.... I don’t know....”
